research_question: How does audience retention during independently timestamped chorus occurrences compare with preregistered adjacent sections in videos with authorized analytics?
population_scope: Only verified videos for which the rights holder has authorized YouTube audience-retention analytics and HookLab has calibrated section boundaries.
robustness_plan: Compare each chorus with matched preceding and following windows; audit repeated viewing and video/song edit mismatch.
stop_promotion_rule: Missing authorization, uncalibrated section boundaries, incomplete retention curves, edit mismatch, unstable contrast or replication failure blocks promotion.
blocked_reason: Public video statistics do not identify chorus-level attention. Audience-retention data require authorization and calibrated content-clock section timestamps.
